photoCheck.title: Photo check

hint.leaf: Photograph one diseased leaf, close up, in daylight.
hint.insects: Photograph one insect, close up. Wide field photos do not work well.
hint.wheat_heading: Photograph the crop from above, looking down at the canopy.
hint.tobacco_lesions: Photograph one leaf, close up, filling the frame.
hint.curd: Photograph the curd (head) from above, close up, in daylight.
hint.bulb: Photograph one bulb, close up, on a plain surface.
hint.fruit_grade: Photograph one tomato, close up, in daylight.
hint.wheat_kernels: Photograph a spread of harvested grain on a plain surface, not the standing crop.

photoCheck.symptomConfirm: I can see disease symptoms on this leaf
photoCheck.symptomRequiredHint: This check can only name a disease. It cannot tell you a leaf is healthy, so use it only when you see symptoms.

leafReason.symptom_required: Confirm that you can see symptoms before checking a leaf.
leafReason.no_model_for_crop: There is no leaf model for this crop.

photoCheck.noneOfTheseChosen: Noted. The problem may be something this check does not cover. Look through the full disease list below or ask your local agriculture officer.
photoCheck.noInsectFound: No insect found in this photo.
photoCheck.notPestOfThisCrop: Not usually a pest of this crop
photoCheck.headingDetected: Heads are visible. The crop has started heading.
photoCheck.headingNotDetected: No heads found. This does not prove heading has not started.
photoCheck.lesionArea: About {{percent}}% of the leaf shows lesions
photoCheck.lesionOverestimates: This measure tends to over-estimate lesion area by about a third.
photoCheck.causeNotIdentified: The photo shows a problem, but this check cannot name its cause.
